name: Create an IdP federation grant
description: Create an IdP federation grant Creates an IdP federation grant for the specified identity provider, making it available for federation to other accounts in the same Cloudflare organization. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/idp_federation_grants
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/idp_federation_grants
Creates an IdP federation grant for the specified identity provider, making it available for federation to other accounts in the same Cloudflare organization. The account must belong to a Cloudflare organization. One-time pin and Cloudflare-managed identity providers cannot be federated. An account can federate at most five identity providers at a time.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete an IdP federation grant
description: Delete an IdP federation grant Deletes an IdP federation grant. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/idp_federation_grants/{grant_id}

name: Get an IdP federation grant
description: Get an IdP federation grant Retrieves a single IdP federation grant by its UID. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/idp_federation_grants/{grant_id}

name: List IdP federation grants
description: List IdP federation grants Lists the IdP federation grants owned by the account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/idp_federation_grants
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/idp_federation_grants
Lists the IdP federation grants owned by the account.
Required: account_id (path)
